featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Truly Unforgettable School Trip Experience with Joshi Travels! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We recently went on a school trip to Manali and Chandigarh with our enthusiastic students from Grades 8 and 10, and I must say — it was one of the best trips ever, all thanks to the exceptional planning and execution by Joshi Travels.

From the very beginning till the end, the trip was handled with such care and dedication. Our tour guides, Dhairya Sir and Viraj Sir, were absolutely outstanding. They went above and beyond to ensure that every child felt safe, seen, and valued. Whether it was managing early wake-up calls, coordinating activities, arranging meals and snacks, or simply making sure every student was tucked in on time — they handled everything seamlessly and with a smile.

What truly stood out was their personal connection with the students — knowing each child by name, patiently attending to their needs, and creating beautiful memories with them. One of the most magical moments was when the students wished to have lunch amidst the snow — and to our surprise, our lunch was delivered via a zip line! It was moments like these that made this trip truly unforgettable.

The accommodation and food at every stop were top-notch, exceeding expectations in both comfort and taste. Every little detail was taken care of, and not once did we feel unorganized or rushed.

Kudos to Dhairya Sir and Viraj Sir for their incredible energy, warmth, and professionalism. Their ability to balance fun with responsibility made all the difference.

I highly recommend Joshi Travels for any school or group tour. Their dedication, planning, and passion for delivering quality experiences are truly commendable. We returned not just with memories, but with hearts full of gratitude.

Thanks to their thoughtful planning and warm hospitality, our trip turned into a truly unforgettable experience. I deeply appreciate all their efforts and would happily recommend Jalsa holidays to anyone looking for a well-organized and delightful travel experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother and I recently had a dissapointing experience with their sales staff Ms Nutan at the Kesari office in Borivali. We had booked an Egypt tour with them. And chose to pay the full amount at once to avail a discount. Ms Nutan showed intrest and was behind us till we paid the money. After the money was paid she became unresponsive. We wanted to check with her if our booking was confirmed? Since a proper receipt for full payment was not provided by her. We called and WhatsApped her and waited for around 2 weeks. But no response. After 2 weeks of frustration my mother had to personally drop by their office to collect the full payment receipt and to check if our seats were booked.
All of this could have been easily done over a call if she cared about proper customer service. The whole experience felt pathetic.
